CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Identified content positions, an explicit organization/presentation (same current node), and an explicit origin/status are all present and bound to the same p0/current/n0 content/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the same content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names content entries (red/blue sets) with positional attributes for current and conditional candidate records.

D.rationale: Origins and execution-status metadata are recorded separately from the content position entries, distinguishing content identity from its record/origin status.

O.rationale: The text specifies how the grid is oriented and presents explicit organized position sets for current content nodes.
